title: Homogeneous basis comparison on polynomial Proj
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with total-degree grading and $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Let $M=\bigoplus_{j\in\mathbf Z}M_j$ be an internally graded $S$-module satisfying $S_nM_j\subseteq M_{n+j}$ for all $n\ge0$. Let $r\ge0$, let $d:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to\mathbf Z$, and let $b_a$ be an $S$-basis with $b_a\in M_{-d_a}$. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_P$-module equipped, on each positive homogeneous standard open $D_+(f)$, with an injective additive map $\alpha_f$ into $M_f$, whose image is exactly the degree-zero fractions [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. Assume $\alpha_f$ is linear over $S_{(f)}$ via the chart ring map, and that restriction along $D_+(g)\subseteq D_+(f)$ sends $y/f^m$ to $a^my/g^{em}$ whenever $e>0$, $a$ is homogeneous and $g^e=af$. Then $F\cong\bigoplus_{a\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)}\operatorname{Proj.twist}(d_a)$. No chart comparison to projective space or pullback occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Apply homogeneous_basis_coordinates to a vector in M_n to obtain the forward coordinate grading implication. Conversely expand the vector using Basis.sum_equivFun, and use scalar compatibility and the homogeneous basis degrees to show every coordinate term is in M_n. For negative d_a+n the coordinate is zero. This proves that b.equivFun identifies the nonnegative numerator degree sets in both directions.

Apply finite_twist_coproduct_fractions directly to the polynomial grading and degree family d, extracting the coproduct chart injections, image equalities, scalar and restriction formulas. No projective-line chart isomorphism or transported glued twist is used.

Apply graded_chart_comparison to the linear equivalence b.equivFun, the just-proved equivalence of numerator degree sets, the supplied charts of F, and the extracted charts of the coproduct. This gives the required isomorphism without choosing stalk maps.

theorem homogeneous_basis_proj_coproduct (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M),
      a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (F : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f M)
    (halpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M)) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s)
    (hres : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M)
          (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (F.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℤ)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) M)
    (hb : ∀ a : Fin r, b a ∈ 𝓜 (-(d a))) :
    Nonempty (F ≅ ∐ (fun a ↦ twist (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (d a)))
